name: curlew-cli
description: Curlew app: the `curlew` binary — CLI + MCP frontends over the @curlew/* packages, bundled to a single .gjs.mjs and run on GJS via gjsify.

scripts.dev: gjsify run build:gjs && gjsify run start
scripts.test: DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS=unix:path=/nonexistent XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/nonexistent LC_ALL=C LANGUAGE= sh -c 'gjsify test --runtime gjs; g=$?; gjsify test --runtime node; n=$?; [ $g -eq 0 ] && [ $n -eq 0 ]'
scripts.test:send-fd-dbus: gjsify build tests/integration/daemon-send-fd-dbus.ts --app gjs --outfile dist/daemon-send-fd-dbus.gjs.mjs && dbus-run-session -- gjsify run dist/daemon-send-fd-dbus.gjs.mjs
scripts.test:notifications-dbus: gjsify build tests/integration/message-notifications-dbus.ts --app gjs --outfile dist/message-notifications-dbus.gjs.mjs && dbus-run-session -- gjsify run dist/message-notifications-dbus.gjs.mjs
scripts.test:autostart-dbus: gjsify build tests/integration/autostart-portal-dbus.ts --app gjs --outfile dist/autostart-portal-dbus.gjs.mjs && dbus-run-session -- gjsify run dist/autostart-portal-dbus.gjs.mjs
scripts.test:access-dbus: gjsify build tests/integration/daemon-access-dbus.ts --app gjs --outfile dist/daemon-access-dbus.gjs.mjs && dbus-run-session -- gjsify run dist/daemon-access-dbus.gjs.mjs
scripts.test:telegram-network: gjsify build tests/integration/telegram-handshake.ts --app gjs --outfile dist/telegram-handshake.gjs.mjs && gjsify run dist/telegram-handshake.gjs.mjs
scripts.test:signal-network: gjsify build tests/integration/signal-provisioning.ts --app gjs --outfile dist/signal-provisioning.gjs.mjs && gjsify run dist/signal-provisioning.gjs.mjs
scripts.test:whatsapp-network: gjsify build tests/integration/whatsapp-qr.ts --app gjs --external jimp,sharp --outfile dist/whatsapp-qr.gjs.mjs && gjsify run dist/whatsapp-qr.gjs.mjs
scripts.test:matrix-e2ee: gjsify build tests/integration/matrix-e2ee-gjs.ts --app gjs --outfile dist/matrix-e2ee.gjs.mjs && node tests/integration/matrix-e2ee.mjs

ship.name: Curlew
ship.summary: Mail, contacts and calendar for you and your agents
ship.description: curlew reads the mail (IMAP), contacts (CardDAV) and calendar (CalDAV) of the accounts already configured in GNOME Online Accounts, as a CLI and an MCP server. Read-only unless a grant says otherwise: it never sets \Seen, and its only write is one granted send to one address. GNOME Online Accounts and Evolution Data Server are Linux-only, so the macOS and Windows packages ship with every account backend unavailable — see the Releasing section of README.md.
